about_the_game:
Try on the role of a simple NPC, who is able to help the heroes in their adventures only indirectly. Your task is to earn as much money as possible, or at least not to go bankrupt....

Help the heroes with suitable equipment to increase their chances of success



Choose your favorites and help them



Find the balance between profit and chutzpah
